verses.en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.pt: Depois disto partiu Jesus para o outro lado do mar da Galiléia, também chamado de Tiberíades.
verses.en_web: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
verses.en_bbe: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee--that is, the sea of Tiberias.

verses.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.pt: E seguia-o uma grande multidão, porque via os sinais que operava sobre os enfermos.
verses.en_web: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
verses.en_bbe: And a great number of people went after him because they saw the signs which he did on those who were ill.

verses.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.pt: Subiu, pois, Jesus ao monte e sentou-se ali com seus discípulos.
verses.en_web: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus went up the mountain and was seated there with his disciples.

verses.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.pt: Ora, a páscoa, a festa dos judeus, estava próxima.
verses.en_web: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.

verses.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.pt: Então Jesus, levantando os olhos, e vendo que uma grande multidão vinha ter com ele, disse a Felipe: Onde compraremos pão, para estes comerem?
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
verses.en_bbe: Lifting up his eyes, Jesus saw a great number of people coming to where he was, and he said to Philip, Where may we get bread for all these people?

verses.en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.pt: Mas dizia isto para o experimentar; pois ele bem sabia o que ia fazer.
verses.en_web: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.en_bbe: This he said, testing him: for he had no doubt what he himself would do.

verses.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Felipe: Duzentos denários de pão não lhes bastam, para que cada um receba um pouco.
verses.en_web: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little.”
verses.en_bbe: Philip made answer, Bread to the value of two hundred pence would not be enough even to give everyone a little.

verses.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,
verses.pt: Ao que lhe disse um dos seus discípulos, André, irmão de Simão Pedro:
verses.en_web: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
verses.en_bbe: One of his disciples, Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, said to Jesus,

verses.en: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.pt: Está aqui um rapaz que tem cinco pães de cevada e dois peixinhos; mas que é isto para tantos?
verses.en_web: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
verses.en_bbe: There is a boy here with five barley cakes and two fishes: but what is that among such a number?

verses.en: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.pt: Disse Jesus: Fazei reclinar-se o povo. Ora, naquele lugar havia muita relva. Reclinaram-se aí, pois, os homens em número de quase cinco mil.
verses.en_web: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said, Let the people be seated. Now there was much grass in that place. And those seated on the grass were about five thousand.

verses.en: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.pt: Jesus, então, tomou os pães e, havendo dado graças, repartiu-os pelos que estavam reclinados; e de igual modo os peixes, quanto eles queriam.
verses.en_web: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus took the cakes and having given praise to God, he gave them to the people who were seated, and the fishes in the same way, as much as they had need of.

verses.en: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.pt: E quando estavam saciados, disse aos seus discípulos: Recolhei os pedaços que sobejaram, para que nada se perca.
verses.en_web: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
verses.en_bbe: And when they had had enough, Jesus said to his disciples, Take up the broken bits which are over, so that nothing may be wasted.

verses.en: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.pt: Recolheram-nos, pois e encheram doze cestos de pedaços dos cinco pães de cevada, que sobejaram aos que haviam comido.
verses.en_web: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.en_bbe: So they took them up: twelve baskets full of broken bits of the five cakes which were over after the people had had enough.

verses.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.pt: Vendo, pois, aqueles homens o sinal que Jesus operara, diziam: este é verdadeiramente o profeta que havia de vir ao mundo.
verses.en_web: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the people saw the sign which he had done, they said, Truly, this is the prophet who is to come into the world.

verses.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.pt: Percebendo, pois, Jesus que estavam prestes a vir e levá-lo à força para o fazerem rei, tornou a retirar-se para o monte, ele sozinho.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Jesus saw that the people were about to come and take him by force to make him a king, he went away again up the mountain by himself.

verses.en: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.pt: Ao cair da tarde, desceram os seus discípulos ao mar;
verses.en_web: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
verses.en_bbe: When evening came the disciples went down to the sea;

verses.en: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.pt: e, entrando num barco, atravessavam o mar em direção a Cafarnaum; enquanto isso, escurecera e Jesus ainda não tinha vindo ter com eles;
verses.en_web: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.en_bbe: And they took a boat and went across the sea in the direction of Capernaum. By then it was dark and still Jesus had not come to them.

verses.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.pt: ademais, o mar se empolava, porque soprava forte vento.
verses.en_web: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
verses.en_bbe: The sea was getting rough because of a strong wind which was blowing.

verses.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.pt: Tendo, pois, remado uns vinte e cinco ou trinta estádios, viram a Jesus andando sobre o mar e aproximando-se do barco; e ficaram atemorizados.
verses.en_web: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
verses.en_bbe: After they had gone three or four miles they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near to the boat; and they had great fear.

verses.en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.pt: Mas ele lhes disse: Sou eu; não temais.
verses.en_web: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
verses.en_bbe: But he said to them, It is I, have no fear.

verses.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.pt: Então eles de boa mente o receberam no barco; e logo o barco chegou à terra para onde iam.
verses.en_web: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
verses.en_bbe: Then they readily took him into the boat: and straight away the boat was at the land to which they were going.

verses.en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.pt: No dia seguinte, a multidão que ficara no outro lado do mar, sabendo que não houvera ali senão um barquinho, e que Jesus não embarcara nele com seus discípulos, mas que estes tinham ido sós
verses.en_web: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.en_bbe: The day after, the people who were on the other side of the sea saw that only one small boat had been there, that Jesus had not gone in that boat with the disciples, but that the disciples had gone away by themselves.

verses.en: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.pt: (contudo, outros barquinhos haviam chegado a Tiberíades para perto do lugar onde comeram o pão, havendo o Senhor dado graças);
verses.en_web: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.en_bbe: Some other boats, however, came from Tiberias near to the place where they had taken the bread after the Lord had given praise.

verses.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.pt: quando, pois, viram que Jesus não estava ali nem os seus discípulos, entraram eles também nos barcos, e foram a Cafarnaum, em busca de Jesus.
verses.en_web: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: So when the people saw that Jesus was not there, or his disciples, they got into those boats and went over to Capernaum looking for Jesus.

verses.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.pt: E, achando-o no outro lado do mar, perguntaram-lhe: Rabi, quando chegaste aqui?
verses.en_web: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
verses.en_bbe: And when they came across him on the other side of the sea they said, Rabbi, when did you come here?

verses.en: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que me buscais, não porque vistes sinais, mas porque comestes do pão e vos saciastes.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus, answering them, said, Truly I say to you, You come after me, not because you saw signs, but because you were given the bread and had enough.

verses.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.pt: Trabalhai, não pela comida que perece, mas pela comida que permanece para a vida eterna, a qual o Filho do homem vos dará; pois neste, Deus, o Pai, imprimiu o seu selo.
verses.en_web: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
verses.en_bbe: Let your work not be for the food which comes to an end, but for the food which goes on for eternal life, which the Son of man will give to you, for on him has God the Father put his mark.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.pt: Pergutaram-lhe, pois: Que havemos de fazer para praticarmos as obras de Deus?
verses.en_web: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
verses.en_bbe: Then they said to him, How may we do the works of God?

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.pt: Jesus lhes respondeu: A obra de Deus é esta: Que creiais naquele que ele enviou.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus, answering, said to them, This is to do the work of God: to have faith in him whom God has sent.

verses.en: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe, então: Que sinal, pois, fazes tu, para que o vejamos e te creiamos? Que operas tu?
verses.en_web: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?
verses.en_bbe: So they said, What sign do you give us, so that we may see and have faith in you? What do you do?

verses.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.pt: Nossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, como está escrito: Do céu deu-lhes pão a comer.
verses.en_web: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
verses.en_bbe: Our fathers had the manna in the waste land, as the Writings say, He gave them bread from heaven.

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: Não foi Moisés que vos deu o pão do céu; mas meu Pai vos dá o verdadeiro pão do céu.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus then said to them, Truly I say to you, What Moses gave you was not the bread from heaven; it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

verses.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.pt: Porque o pão de Deus é aquele que desce do céu e dá vida ao mundo.
verses.en_web: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
verses.en_bbe: The bread of God is the bread which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Senhor, dá-nos sempre desse pão.
verses.en_web: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
verses.en_bbe: Ah, Lord, they said, give us that bread for ever!

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.pt: Declarou-lhes Jesus. Eu sou o pão da vida; aquele que vem a mim, de modo algum terá fome, e quem crê em mim jamais tará sede.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
verses.en_bbe: And this was the answer of Jesus: I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will never be in need of food, and he who has faith in me will never be in need of drink.

verses.en: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.pt: Mas como já vos disse, vós me tendes visto, e contudo não credes.
verses.en_web: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
verses.en_bbe: But it is as I said to you: you have seen me, and still you have no faith.

verses.en: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.pt: Todo o que o Pai me dá virá a mim; e o que vem a mim de maneira nenhuma o lançarei fora.
verses.en_web: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
verses.en_bbe: Whatever the Father gives to me will come to me; and I will not send away anyone who comes to me.

verses.en: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.pt: Porque eu desci do céu, não para fazer a minha vontade, mas a vontade daquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my pleasure, but the pleasure of him who sent me.

verses.en: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.pt: E a vontade do que me enviou é esta: Que eu não perca nenhum de todos aqueles que me deu, mas que eu o ressuscite no último dia.
verses.en_web: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the pleasure of him who sent me, that I am not to let out of my hands anything which he has given me, but I am to give it new life on the last day.

verses.en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.pt: Porquanto esta é a vontade de meu Pai: Que todo aquele que vê o Filho e crê nele, tenha a vida eterna; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
verses.en_web: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
verses.en_bbe: This, I say, is my Father's pleasure, that everyone who sees the Son and has faith in him may have eternal life: and I will take him up on the last day.

verses.en: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.pt: Murmuravam, pois, dele os judeus, porque dissera: Eu sou o pão que desceu do céu;
verses.en_web: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the Jews said bitter things about Jesus because of his words, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

verses.en: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.pt: e perguntavam: Não é Jesus, o filho de José, cujo pai e mãe nós conhecemos? Como, pois, diz agora: Desci do céu?
verses.en_web: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we have seen? How is it then that he now says, I have come down from heaven?

verses.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Não murmureis entre vós.
verses.en_web: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus made answer and said, Do not say things against me, one to another.

verses.en: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.pt: Ninguém pode vir a mim, se o Pai que me enviou não o trouxer; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
verses.en_web: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
verses.en_bbe: No man is able to come to me if the Father who sent me does not give him the desire to come: and I will take him up from the dead on the last day.

verses.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.pt: Está escrito nos profetas: E serão todos ensinados por Deus. Portanto todo aquele que do Pai ouviu e aprendeu vem a mim.
verses.en_web: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.
verses.en_bbe: The writings of the prophets say, And they will all have teaching from God. Everyone whose ears have been open to the teaching of the Father comes to me.

verses.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.pt: Não que alguém tenha visto o Pai, senão aquele que é vindo de Deus; só ele tem visto o Pai.
verses.en_web: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
verses.en_bbe: Not that anyone has ever seen the Father; only he who is from God, he has seen the Father.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: Aquele que crê tem a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, He who has faith in me has eternal life.

verses.en: I am that bread of life.
verses.pt: Eu sou o pão da vida.
verses.en_web: I am the bread of life.
verses.en_bbe: I am the bread of life.

verses.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.pt: Vossos pais comeram o maná no deserto e morreram.
verses.en_web: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
verses.en_bbe: Your fathers took the manna in the waste land--and they are dead.

verses.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.pt: Este é o pão que desce do céu, para que o que dele comer não morra.
verses.en_web: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
verses.en_bbe: The bread which comes from heaven is such bread that a man may take it for food and never see death.

verses.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.pt: Eu sou o pão vivo que desceu do céu; se alguém comer deste pão, viverá para sempre; e o pão que eu darei pela vida do mundo é a minha carne.
verses.en_web: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
verses.en_bbe: I am the living bread which has come from heaven: if any man takes this bread for food he will have life for ever: and more than this, the bread which I will give is my flesh which I will give for the life of the world.

verses.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.pt: Disputavam, pois, os judeus entre si, dizendo: Como pode este dar-nos a sua carne a comer?
verses.en_web: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Jews had an angry discussion among themselves, saying, How is it possible for this man to give us his flesh for food?

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: Se não comerdes a carne do Filho do homem, e não beberdes o seu sangue, não tereis vida em vós mesmos.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, If you do not take the flesh of the Son of man for food, and if you do not take his blood for drink, you have no life in you.

verses.en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.pt: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue tem a vida eterna; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
verses.en_web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.en_bbe: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink has eternal life: and I will take him up from the dead at the last day.

verses.en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.pt: Porque a minha carne verdadeiramente é comida, e o meu sangue verdadeiramente é bebida.
verses.en_web: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.en_bbe: My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.

verses.en: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.pt: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue permanece em mim e eu nele.
verses.en_web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
verses.en_bbe: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink is in me and I in him.

verses.en: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.pt: Assim como o Pai, que vive, me enviou, e eu vivo pelo Pai, assim, quem de mim se alimenta, também viverá por mim.
verses.en_web: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
verses.en_bbe: As the living Father has sent me, and I have life because of the Father, even so he who takes me for his food will have life because of me.

verses.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.pt: Este é o pão que desceu do céu; não é como o caso de vossos pais, que comeram o maná e morreram; quem comer este pão viverá para sempre.
verses.en_web: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
verses.en_bbe: This is the bread which has come down from heaven. It is not like the food which your fathers had: they took of the manna, and are dead; but he who takes this bread for food will have life for ever.

verses.en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.pt: Estas coisas falou Jesus quando ensinava na sinagoga em Cafarnaum.
verses.en_web: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said these things in the Synagogue while he was teaching at Capernaum.

verses.en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.pt: Muitos, pois, dos seus discípulos, ouvindo isto, disseram: Duro é este discurso; quem o pode ouvir?
verses.en_web: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
verses.en_bbe: Then, hearing this, a number of his disciples said, This is a hard saying; who is able to take in such teaching?

verses.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.pt: Mas, sabendo Jesus em si mesmo que murmuravam disto os seus discípulos, disse-lhes: Isto vos escandaliza?
verses.en_web: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
verses.en_bbe: When Jesus became conscious that his disciples were protesting about what he said, he said to them, Does this give you trouble?

verses.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.pt: Que seria, pois, se vísseis subir o Filho do homem para onde primeiro estava?
verses.en_web: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
verses.en_bbe: What then will you say if you see the Son of man going up to where he was before?

verses.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.pt: O espírito é o que vivifica, a carne para nada aproveita; as palavras que eu vos tenho dito são espírito e são vida.
verses.en_web: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
verses.en_bbe: The spirit is the life giver; the flesh is of no value: the words which I have said to you are spirit and they are life.

verses.en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.pt: Mas há alguns de vós que não crêem. Pois Jesus sabia, desde o princípio, quem eram os que não criam, e quem era o que o havia de entregar.
verses.en_web: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
verses.en_bbe: But still some of you have no faith. For it was clear to Jesus from the first who they were who had no faith, and who it was who would be false to him.

verses.en: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.pt: E continuou: Por isso vos disse que ninguém pode vir a mim, se pelo Pai lhe não for concedido.
verses.en_web: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, This is why I said to you, No man is able to come to me if he is not given the power to do so by the Father.

verses.en: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.pt: Por causa disso muitos dos seus discípulos voltaram para trás e não andaram mais com ele.
verses.en_web: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.en_bbe: Because of what he said, a number of the disciples went back and would no longer go with him.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.pt: Perguntou então Jesus aos doze: Quereis vós também retirar-vos?
verses.en_web: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
verses.en_bbe: So Jesus said to the twelve, Have you a desire to go away?

verses.en: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, para quem iremos nós? Tu tens as palavras da vida eterna.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: Then Simon Peter gave this answer: Lord, to whom are we to go? you have the words of eternal life;

verses.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.pt: E nós já temos crido e bem sabemos que tu és o Santo de Deus.
verses.en_web: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.en_bbe: And we have faith and are certain that you are the Holy One of God.

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Não vos escolhi a vós os doze? Contudo um de vós é o diabo.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said, Did I not make a selection of you, the twelve, and one of you is a son of the Evil One?

verses.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.pt: Referia-se a Judas, filho de Simão Iscariotes; porque era ele o que o havia de entregar, sendo um dos doze.
verses.en_web: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.en_bbe: He was talking of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. It was he who was to be false to Jesus--one of the twelve.
